That's how I figured out that my enemy highlighting is very botched (only specifically when I change vision direction) meaning that enemy highlight doesn't get restored when I look away then look back. Back to highlighting and vision, I optimized rendering to my fullest ability, having to add many edge cases after. This did not really help the lag that much, and the biggest optimization I can make will probably be in the determine light levels. I will have to pre-compute every ray (meaning that I'll add another for loop inside the_pattern_forge yay!!!!!!!). I'll report on that when it's done.

Absolutely massive changes have come. I switched my LOS vision to shadowcasting!!!! Hopefully vision is optimized now. (I used AI though, so minus points for me) Also I'm pretty sure I got speed down. What I did was get the speed of all the entities, organized them using another dict, then looped through that dict (which goes from greatest to least speed) to find out which entity goes first. Also, I brought back player highlighting becoming maroon when weapon is equipped and highlighting diagonally.

Made an opaque objects list which would add shadows instead of using just game.wall. There was a bug where vision didn't work properly when a player moved while highlighting diagonally, fixed it by readding determine vision direction to steps after pressing wasd. Made inventory font large font again instead of super small (that was supposed to be for dungeon tiles). Updated level 1 to have as many jail cells as possible. I also created locked bars, and I made it so that they are the ones that can be opened by keys instead of bars. That should be all.
Added locked bar to level 0
